name: Logo
intent: Brand logo: the full wordmark or the mark alone, in fixed brand colors.
usage: Use the default wordmark in app headers and sign-in screens. Use the symbol alone where space is tight, like a collapsed sidebar. Brand colors are fixed and never follow the theme tokens. In dark theme the wordmark text switches to the white reverse; the mark never changes. See contracts/logo.json for the full contract.

variant.note: default = mark + wordmark (145 x 28). symbol = mark only (22 x 32 frame).

useWhen: App header, sign-in and other brand moments.
Collapsed navigation or tight spaces, using the symbol.
doNot: Do not recolor, retint or tokenize the logo. Brand colors are fixed.
Do not redraw it, use an image of it, or paste the SVG into a screen. Use this component.
Do not stretch or resize it with custom px.
Do not use the symbol where the full wordmark fits and reads better.
a11y: When the logo is inside a link, the label names the link.

examples.title: Default
examples.usage: The full wordmark. Primary use in headers and sign-in screens.

examples.title: Symbol
examples.usage: The mark alone for tight spaces, like a collapsed sidebar.
